AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!

I brought my pet here because my usual vet was fully booked due to the heatwave. My experience was mixed. My pet is old but very lively (something the vet complimented). Then, when I picked him up, I was told they had to sedate him (when an animal is old, the least they could do is call the owner to let them know).
The medication they gave my pet left him in a rather worrying state for a while (lethargy, difficulty eating). When we stopped the treatment, because we weren't satisfied with his condition, it took quite some time, but we finally got our pet back to his true self.

WE ARE CURRENTLY AT ANOTHER VET WHO IS OUTRAGED BY THE PRACTICE (seizing an old cat without the owner's consent + shaving his fur).

Dr. Derré is an excellent veterinarian, very clear in his explanations and, above all, highly competent. He treated and saved my little Westie, Emmie, from a complex illness, and I was beyond thrilled. All the staff at this clinic are top-notch in every way.

In short, I highly recommend this veterinary clinic and can't thank Dr. Derré enough!

Thank you all!
Valérie and Emmie
